tallyback.invocation: node <pinned worktree>/dist/cli.js, exposed on PATH as `tallyback`
tallyback.skill: bridge/claude-code/skills/tallyback/SKILL.md at the pinned sha, installed as the project skill .claude/skills/tallyback/SKILL.md in every seed

tiny-cache.purpose: cold-start usability and Tallyback overhead on an easy fix
tiny-cache.seeded_defect: expired entry is recomputed but its stored_at is not refreshed, so the next call recomputes again

config-migrate.purpose: epistemic discipline: green existing suite does not prove criterion 3
config-migrate.seeded_defect: v1->v2 migration builds a fresh dict with only version/request_timeout/plugins, dropping unrelated keys

retry-worker.seeded_defect: (1) oversized item silently dropped via `continue`; (2) flush appends the current batch even when empty, so an oversized item at a batch start yields an empty batch — still failing after the naive fix of (1)

environment.claude_flags: -p <prompt.txt> --model <id> --output-format stream-json --verbose --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources project --allowedTools 'Bash Read Edit Write Glob Grep Skill TodoWrite Agent Task'
environment.isolation: fresh deterministic seed repo per run in a neutrally named directory; fresh .tallyback; fresh non-persisted-to-other-runs Claude session; no MCP servers; project setting source only; no human intervention
